headline: Building tools that stay in flow
narrative: Quiet week in Stockholm, focused on cursor-commands and shipflow. Lower commit count but surgical work—comparing agents, refining the interaction, moving between high-level vision and tiny edits without leaving context. The overcast skies match the heads-down intensity.

sections.title: Cursor commands
sections.content: Deep work on cursor-commands and shipflow. Contributing PRs, refining point-and-click editing for Next.js. The pattern: surgical moves over sweeping rewrites. Building tools that let you set the vision while agents handle execution—staying in flow, never leaving context.

sections.title: Building in public
sections.content: Recent posts about comparing agents side-by-side, moving from codebase to roadmap with cursor, and the philosophy that best builds happen in steps. Quiet week on X but the themes persist: AI agents as collaborators, vision-driven development, surgical iterations.

footer: Overcast Stockholm winter, 9°C and steady. Building tools in the quiet, where dream pop meets trip hop and code flows like surgical precision.
